entries.text: 我們這麼突然來打擾，\n卻還是吃到了一頓大餐呢！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_00

entries.text: 對吧！對吧！超同意！\n而且還那麼漂亮，嚇到人家了。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_01

entries.text: 阿姨還記得我，\n我好開心喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_01

entries.text: 房間也很厲害！\n比宿舍寬敞太多了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_02

entries.text: 雖說感覺有點太過可愛了……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_03

entries.text: 哦～是Nintendo Switch！\n好好奇有些什麼遊戲～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_02

entries.text: 貪心栗鼠布偶！\n真好！毛茸茸的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_02

entries.text: 大家都吃飽了嗎？\n要不要來些點心？[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_01

entries.text: 不用不用！這怎麼好意思！\n妳……您太客氣了！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_04

entries.text: 嘻嘻，\n不用那麼拘謹沒關係的。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_02

entries.text: 把這裡當成自己的家，\n好好放鬆吧。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_03

entries.text: 寄件人叫做烏栗。\n……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳認識這個人嗎？[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_05

entries.text: 哎呀，這樣啊……？\n總之我把信交給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_07

entries.text: 我去拿點心，\n你們好好期待吧。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_09

entries.text: 好好奇點心是什麼～！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_04

entries.text: 話說回來，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不打開信封看看嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]

[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳過得還好嗎？
我跟學園請了假，回到了翠綠鎮。
我姐也一起回來了。
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_system_01

entries.text:
自從大空洞那次以來，一直沒什麼機會見面，
讓我很想再見[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一次。
方便的話，要不要和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在帕底亞的朋友
一起來北上鄉一趟呢？
我放了幾張票在信裡。
我姐也很期待能見到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_system_02

entries.text: 那傢伙是誰啊？\n……是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳朋友嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_08

entries.text: 是朋友！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_01

entries.text: 差不多吧
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_02

entries.text: 什麼叫差不多啊？\n嗯……算了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_10

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]～！派帕！\n點心比我想像的還厲害耶～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_04

entries.text: 拿上去不太方便，\n來下面吃吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_05

entries.text: 妮莫的聲音也太大了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_11

entries.text: 真拿她沒辦法。\n我們過去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_12

entries.text: 啊～肚子好撐啊～\n再也吃不下了～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_05

entries.text: 妳至少說聲謝謝款待吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_13

entries.text: 我來幫忙洗碗！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_06

entries.text: 妮莫，謝謝妳。\n但是沒關係，妳休息就好。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_10

entries.text: 不愧是妮莫，\n真懂事啊。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_14

entries.text: ……是叫北上鄉的地方來著？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_17

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又要去那裡\n見那個叫烏栗的人了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_18

entries.text: 我們一起去吧！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_03

entries.text: 大家一起去吧！
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_select_04

entries.text: 什麼，什麼！？\n你們在聊什麼～！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_08

entries.text: 哎唷～！這種情況，\n那肯定是要一起去的啦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_09

entries.text: 對戰強校的冠軍耶！\n我也想和烏栗見一面～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_10

entries.text: 妳是說「打一場」吧？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_08

entries.text: 真是抱歉啦……\n好像在強迫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳邀請我們去了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_20

entries.text: 對方都送了票，\n要[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和朋友一起去了嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_12

entries.text: 那不就是我們嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_09

entries.text: 和朋友一起旅行……\n人家還是第一次。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_10

entries.text: 總覺得……有點緊張起來了。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_12

entries.text: 這麼說來……\n我好像也是這樣。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_21

entries.text: 哦～這樣啊！\n很令人期待對不對！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_14

entries.text: 我還是去跟家裡的幫傭說一聲\n要去旅行的事好了。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_15

entries.text: 大家應該也需要做些準備。\n我們先暫時解散，之後再集合吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_rival_16

entries.text: 好！那就……\n在[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]桌台市的南門前[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]見！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_friend_22

entries.text: OK～！\n那就之後見了！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_botan_13

entries.text: 哎呀，妮莫她們\n已經回去了啊。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_11

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的朋友們都是好孩子，\n連媽媽我也開心起來了。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_12

entries.text: 這次你們是要\n一起出門去冒險對吧。[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_13

entries.text: 不要吵架，要好好相處喔。\n祝你們一路平安！[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0020_mama_14
